newsitem.title: UK: Mexico plans 500 billion lire 10-year bond - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Mexico plans 500 billion lire 10-year bond - dealers.

text.p: Mexico plans to launch a 500 billion lire ($325 million) 10-year Eurobond at the end of January or early February, syndicate managers said on Tuesday.
Chase was tipped as lead manager but officials there declined to comment.
Last week Mexico launched a $1.0 billion 10-year global bond and the lira deal would complete most of its funding needs for 1997, dealers said.
"Mexico will not be as prominent in the market as last year," said a syndicate manager at a U.S. bank.
Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) will launch a 300 billion lire five-year deal this week via Credito Italiano, Merrill Lynch and Paribas.
BNDES will be the first emerging market credit in lira this year. In 1996 Latin American borrowers were busy in the sector.
